rules.name: PowerShell Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detect encoded PowerShell, -bypass, hidden window, and download cradle patterns
rules.query: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_137", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%powershell%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%execution%') AND "value" > 0
